data.one_liner: Multi-page bottom sheet library with internal navigation and smooth transitions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable bottom sheet component that acts like a Navigator, allowing users to push and pop multiple pages inside a single modal sheet. It supports smooth page transitions, custom layouts, and appearance configurations similar to standard Flutter bottom sheets.
use_when: You need complex multi-step user flows inside a modal bottom sheet
You want seamless page transitions inside a bottom sheet like a nested Navigator
You need a bottom sheet design inspired by the Family app or Wolt modal sheets
avoid_when: You only need a single static view inside a modal bottom sheet
You want to use standard Flutter navigation routes directly without a sheet wrapper
strengths: Supports internal page navigation (push/pop) inside a bottom sheet
Extensive customization for both content area and outer sheet appearance
weaknesses: Relatively new package with a single initial major release
Limited documentation beyond basic README usage and configuration options

alternatives.name: modal_bottom_sheet
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides alternative modal bottom sheet transitions and styles such as Cupertino modal sheets.

alternatives.name: animations
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides pre-built Material motion and container transform animations if you are building custom transitions.
